sources.title: Amazon S3 multipart upload limits
sources.version_or_commit: Current rolling AWS S3 User Guide; no immutable revision displayed.

sources.title: Uploading and copying objects using multipart upload in Amazon S3
sources.version_or_commit: Current rolling AWS S3 User Guide; no immutable revision displayed.
sources.locator: ‘Initiate’, ‘Parts upload’, ‘Multipart upload completion’, ‘Multipart upload listings’, and ‘Checksums with multipart upload operations’; displayed lines 28–69 and 72.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Initiation gives upload ID and takes object metadata; completion uses part numbers/ETags in order; ETag not necessarily MD5; upload parts remain stored/billed until complete/abort; ListParts paginates at 1,000 and is not the completion manifest; checksum MPU requires consecutive part numbers from 1; full-object checksum mismatch is BadDigest.
sources.applicability: AWS operation lifecycle and checksum behavior. Check matching endpoint semantics before implementation.

critic_review.version_or_commit: Current rolling AWS S3 User Guide; no immutable revision displayed.
critic_review.locator: Lines 25–67, 83–91, and checksum header/type table lines 168–176.
critic_review.observed_operation: AWS S3 multipart lifecycle, completion, checksums and checksum types
critic_review.governing_condition_default_exception: Tracks upload IDs and own part/ETag manifest; listings omit unfinished parts; ETag not necessarily MD5; full-object checksum mismatch yields BadDigest; checksum uploads require consecutive part numbers; full-object CRC algorithms are distinct from composite SHA-family algorithms.
critic_review.applicability: AWS behavior only; archive operation/header profile needs owner confirmation.

sources.title: Checking object integrity in Amazon S3
sources.version_or_commit: Current rolling AWS S3 User Guide; no immutable revision displayed.
sources.locator: Overview lines 5–9 and note/verification behavior lines 31–37; multipart checksum table in AWS-03.
sources.observed_operation: AWS single/multipart object upload checksum validation and later checksum retrieval.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: AWS S3 calculates an independent checksum and validates a supplied checksum; precomputed checksums on MPU require full-object checksum type for a full-object claim; composite values are distinct from direct whole-object digest.
sources.applicability: Integrity recommendation only when the archive provider supports the selected algorithm/type and returns/retrieves it as expected.

critic_review.version_or_commit: Current rolling AWS S3 User Guide; no immutable revision displayed.
critic_review.observed_operation: AWS S3 checksum algorithms and server-side validation
critic_review.governing_condition_default_exception: AWS lists available algorithms and independently validates supplied upload checksums; the page alone does not identify the MPU full-object algorithm matrix, which is in AWS-03.
critic_review.applicability: Supports integrity discussion, but do not infer that every algorithm is a full-object MPU checksum.

sources.title: How to prevent object overwrites with conditional writes
sources.version_or_commit: Current rolling AWS S3 User Guide; no immutable revision displayed.
sources.locator: If-None-Match applicability lines 34–44; response semantics and conditional multipart scenarios lines 93–122.
sources.observed_operation: PutObject and CompleteMultipartUpload with If-None-Match: *; optional If-Match.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: If-None-Match tests the current version; existing object returns 412; concurrent delete can yield 409, and multipart must be reinitiated after 409; policy is AWS behavior.
sources.applicability: Possible storage-level no-overwrite guard, only if owner’s provider/version confirms conditional completion. Does not define database idempotency or curator duplicate policy.

critic_review.version_or_commit: Current rolling AWS S3 User Guide; no immutable revision displayed.
critic_review.observed_operation: AWS S3 conditional writes on PutObject and CompleteMultipartUpload
critic_review.governing_condition_default_exception: If-None-Match checks current key/version and may yield 412; a concurrent delete case can yield 409, requiring a fresh multipart initiation after CompleteMultipartUpload.
critic_review.applicability: Optional AWS no-overwrite guard, not archive-provider capability or DB idempotency.

sources.title: Configuring lifecycle to delete incomplete multipart uploads
sources.version_or_commit: Current rolling AWS S3 User Guide; no immutable revision displayed.
sources.locator: Example lifecycle behavior lines 19–25; rule setup lines 37–48.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: AWS owner configures a selected age; the example uses seven days. The rule aborts incomplete MPUs only and does not delete completed objects; no default auto-abort is asserted.

critic_review.version_or_commit: Current rolling AWS S3 User Guide; no immutable revision displayed.
critic_review.governing_condition_default_exception: Owner configures a day count; the example uses seven days; abort removes incomplete parts and does not delete completed objects.
critic_review.applicability: Backstop subject to owner-approved retention and endpoint support.

sources.title: Resumable Upload Protocol 1.0.x
sources.locator: Core HEAD/PATCH resume lines 65–99 and 128–143; max size/server negotiation lines 117–123 and 146–168; expiration lines 249–276; checksum extension lines 277–297.
sources.observed_operation: HEAD reads Upload-Offset; PATCH applies bytes at that offset; optional checksum extension validates each PATCH body; OPTIONS advertises extensions and Tus-Max-Size.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Core resume needs a known upload URL and offset; checksum is optional and per request, with SHA1 minimum if extension supported; server may expire unfinished uploads and must advertise expiration; no storage provider is mandated.
sources.applicability: Analogous resumability mechanism, not an S3 multipart promise or final whole-object integrity proof.

critic_review.locator: HEAD/PATCH lines 57–99; expiry lines 246–276; checksum lines 277–297.
critic_review.governing_condition_default_exception: HEAD reads offset; PATCH resumes; expiry is server-advertised; optional checksum validates each PATCH body, not the entire final object.
critic_review.applicability: Protocol analogue, not S3 behavior or whole-object integrity.
